text:
Anna K.: hey team — starting onboard for raven-13b (chat) today. goal: perf baseline + int8/int4 quant smoke + ctx sweep. asking for quick intake: what we should prioritize, minimal bench checklist, and owners.

Priya S.: +1. prioritize 1) 8k ctx latency p95 2) throughput at small batch sizes (bs=1..8) 3) int8 quality smoke vs fp16 on our eval suite.

Mike L.: suggested commands (local bench harness):
```
./bench/run_bench.sh --model raven-13b --ctx 8192 --batch-sizes 1,2,4,8 --tokens 512 --profile kv,warmup
./bench/quant_eval.py --model raven-13b --q 8bit --evalset eval-reasoning-1k.jsonl
```
Use 5 runs / config and take median.

Jun T.: add ctx sweep steps: 512, 2048, 8192, 16384. watch memory growth and kv-cache hit metrics. flag if OOMs at >=16k.

Anna K.: also capture these micro-metrics in console: avg_token_latency, p50/p95, gpu_mem_alloc, kv_cache_hits, batching_efficiency. bench-bot will post CSVs.

bench-bot: uploaded initial baseline CSV: s3://redwood-test/raven13b/baseline/3054321987_baseline.csv :thumbsup:

Priya S.: quick notes from first run: fp16 single replica p95 @ 8k ctx and bs=1 = 160ms/token, throughput ~52 tok/s. coldstart p95 much higher ~220ms/token. caching warmup reduces to ~140ms after 3k tokens.

Mike L.: int8 quant smoke (symmetric per-layer) results: p95 increased ~8-12ms, throughput +18%. quality delta on eval-reasoning small but visible on long-form (>256 tokens) — need sample diffs.

Anna K.: post diff examples (from quant run) for triage:
```
REF: The algorithm uses dynamic programming to compute...
Q8: The algorithm is using dynamic program and computes...
```
small hallucination shift, tracking under eval id Q8-3054321987.

Jun T.: observed weird tokenization edge at ctx=16384 where batching drops — looks like padding/seq-align bug in runtime. filing infra ticket. @Mike L. can you add a unit test for seq-align?

Mike L.: yup. will add test and run nightly.

Priya S.: propose pass/fail thresholds for onboarding:
- latency p95 (8k ctx, bs=1) <= 200ms token (fp16 baseline)
- quant int8 quality drift <= 1.5% on eval-metric loss and no regression on safety/evals
- throughput increase > 10% for int8 vs fp16
If any fail, defer canary.

Anna K.: owners/next steps:
- perf bench sweep (ctx + batch): Mike L. (run full grid, upload results)
- quant smoke + eval diffs: Priya S. (generate sample diffs, delta heatmap)
- runtime seq-align check + kv-cache regression: Jun T. (investigate padding issue)
- consolidate artifacts + rollout recommendation: Anna K.

bench-bot: bench job 3054321999 queued on cluster-gpu-a (gpus=4)

Mike L.: quick findings from batching sweep (bs 1->16, ctx 8k):
- bs1 p95 160ms/token
- bs2 p95 92ms/token (good parallelism)
- bs4 p95 60ms/token
- bs8 p95 48ms/token but throughput gains plateau after bs8, memory tradeoffs grow large
notes: continuous-batching improves tail latency by ~10% under steady load.

Priya S.: quality check: int8 eval-run vs fp16 on eval-reasoning-1k: micro-F1 drop 0.9%, exact-match -0.6%. flagging a few failure cases where numbers truncate; looks like quantization-induced tokenization scoring diffs.

Anna K.: decision rubric for next 48h: if int8 quality <1.5% drift and perf meets thresholds, we can push canary to dedicated pool (1 replica) and monitor. if not, hold and do mixed-precision fallback.

Jun T.: infra ticket LINK: https://internal/issues/INFRA-1325 — root cause = seq align with pad tokens > config.max_align. workaround: force trim padding for batch packing. I'll land a patch tomorrow.

Mike L.: added bench artifacts to PR: https://git.internal/redwood/bench/PR-4129. includes scripts to reproduce pathological ctx=16k run.

Priya S.: small manual eval examples attached in S3: s3://redwood-test/raven13b/qual-diffs/Q8_examples.jsonl — please review before canary.

Anna K.: final checklist before canary (tick when done):
- [ ] full perf grid results uploaded
- [ ] int8 quality report + examples uploaded
- [ ] infra alignment patch merged / staging verified
- [ ] canary deployment config + rollback policy defined
- [ ] alerts on eval-metric regression and latency SLOs created

Jun T.: I'll own infra + alerting. aiming to have patch + staging verified by EOD tomorrow.

Mike L.: I'll finish the perf grid and upload CSV + flamegraphs by EOD today.

Priya S.: I'll run a focused human review on the 30 hardest diffs and summarize severity.

Anna K.: perfect. dropping here — will re-open if blockers. thanks! :rocket:
